Civil & Structural Engineering — Four-Year Curriculum

Twenty-four courses, eight semesters. How buildings, bridges, foundations, roads and water systems are analyzed and designed: surveying, mechanics of materials, structural analysis, soils, hydraulics, loads and codes, concrete, steel and timber design, foundations, transportation, coastal and wind engineering, and professional practice. Builds on the math and physics core in Biomedical Engineering Foundations. A study aid only; real structures must be designed and sealed by a licensed engineer.
